m: A Sunday arvo job. Cut the chuck into big chunks, season well and brown hard in a heavy pot in batches. Set aside.
Turn the heat down. Cook the diced onion and carrot in the same pot for 10 minutes until soft, then the garlic for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook 2 minutes until it darkens. Add the crushed tomatoes, oregano, stock powder and enough water to just cover the beef.
Lid on, low simmer for 3 hours (or 160°C in the oven) until the beef falls apart. Stir every 45 minutes and top up with water if it gets thick.
Shred the beef in the pot with two forks and simmer uncovered 15 minutes to thicken. Taste and season.
Cook the pasta, keep a mug of pasta water, and toss through the ragu with a splash of that water. Finish with parmesan and parsley.
l: Keep the pasta water to loosen it when reheating. It honestly eats better the next day.
g: GF pasta in a separate pot with its own spoon, sauced from the main pot before the regular pasta goes in. Check the stock powder.
